red_team_issues: BUG1 (Critical): storyforge_auth_failures_total is always 0 — MetricsCollector.increment_auth_failures() is never called from routes.py. The metric exists in /metrics output but is wired to nothing. Brute-force detection via dashboard metrics is completely blind.

BUG2 (High – Race Condition): HALF_OPEN circuit breaker allows N concurrent probes simultaneously. Lock is released before calling func(), so multiple threads all see HALF_OPEN and bypass the single-probe intent.

BUG3 (High – Prometheus Spec Violation): metrics.py emits both labeled samples (rate_limit_hits_total{endpoint='/login'} 2) AND an unlabeled aggregate line (rate_limit_hits_total 3) for the same metric family. This breaks Prometheus text format spec 4.1.2 — a real Prometheus scrape fails with a parse error on first rate limit event.
BUG4 (Medium): _parse_traceparent() accepts uppercase hex but W3C Trace Context spec mandates lowercase. Propagated trace-ids from upstream with uppercase are not normalized.
BUG5 (Medium): total_requests counter is always 1 ahead of duration_count in every /metrics snapshot — increment fires before call_next(), duration fires after.
BUG6 (Medium): _ip_bucket() accepts invalid IPv4 octets (e.g. 256.x.x.x) silently. All IPv6 addresses map to 'unknown', meaning all IPv6 clients share one auth-failure bucket.

FINDING7 (Medium): _fire_webhook() retries synchronously — 3 attempts × 5s timeout + 6s sleep = 21s potential block on the login request thread. Circuit breaker only helps after 5 consecutive failures.
FINDING8 (Low): Future traceparent versions (>00) are rejected rather than forward-compatible parsed per W3C spec.
FINDING9 (Low): /metrics has no authentication — any network-reachable client reads internal operational data.
FINDING10 (Low): Weak session secret passes /readyz HTTP 200 but causes /health HTTP 207. Operators alerting on /readyz status codes only are not notified of the weak secret.
property_violations: Uppercase hex in incoming traceparent (e.g. 00-AAAABBBB...-1111...-01) is propagated without lowercasing, violating W3C Trace Context spec
Invalid IPv4 octet 256 accepted by _ip_bucket() without range validation
All IPv6 addresses including ::1 (loopback) mapped to 'unknown' auth bucket — one attacker's failures affect all IPv6 users
